description: The Sustainable Aviation Technology Dashboard provides an interactive environment for evaluating alternative energy sources for aviation. The Laboratory for Electric Aircraft Design and Sustainability at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign publishes it to examine sustainable aviation fuel, batteries and hydrogen propulsion. Its JORS description identifies physics, economic and environmental models combined for scenario analysis and indicator visualisation. Coverage follows the selected technology assumptions and scenarios; the repository does not specify a fixed geographic domain, historical observation period or universal numerical resolution. GitHub provides the source under AGPL-3.0, and the README links a publicly hosted dashboard and video tutorials. The README states that the hosted application is free to use without local installation. A limitation is that the short repository overview does not establish the validity or currency of every technology assumption. The tool can support comparisons of aviation energy pathways and associated infrastructure needs. Related records were not linked because no direct model interface was verified; an exact equivalent was absent from the catalogue and earlier drafts. This review checked the code repository and documentation, without exercising the hosted dashboard or reproducing its results.
